title: applied-ml-weekly-notes-2026-03-17
content:
Applied ML weekly research notes — 2026-03-17

Summary:
- Focus this week on quantization experiments (GPTQ vs AWQ variants), expanding eval coverage for model onboarding, and straighforward perf/latency benches for newly onboarded Llama-3 and Mistral forks.
- Early AWQ(4-bit) runs look promising on memory and latency; small accuracy regressions on a few tasks that we need to characterize (prompt engineering vs quantization artifact).
- Action items: finalize eval harness additions, finish PR for continuous quantization perf dashboards, and prepare a canary rollout plan for Llama-3-small-q4 and Llama-3-small-awq-q4.

Attendees:
- Maya Singh (owner)
- Avi Patel
- Ethan Liu
- Sofia Martinez
- Liam O'Connor
- (joined late) Priya Rao

Standup / quick updates:
- Maya: Coordinating AWQ vs GPTQ evals. Spun up 8x GPU batch for p50/p95 latency runs. Preparing canary rollout doc.
- Avi: Finished tokenizer edge-case fuzzing for Llama-3-mini. Found 3 sequences that cause KV-cache eviction bug in runtime (filed RID-1876).
- Ethan: Eval harness updates: added instruction-following subset and additional QA pairs from internal eval set; running nightly.
- Sofia: Worked on metrics UI for per-model quantization comparison (throughput, memory, quality delta). Basic charts done, need backend hooks.
- Liam: Onboarding Mistral-8x: compiled ONNX runtime path and collected initial perf numbers.

Research highlights — Quantization:
- Experiments run this week:
  - GPTQ q4_0 (per-channel symmetric rounding) on Llama-3-small (13B-distilled variant)
  - AWQ 4-bit asymmetric mixed (fine-tuned AWQ recipe) on same checkpoint
  - Baseline fp16 and int8 (where supported) for comparison
- Resource setup:
  - 8x A100 80GB nodes for throughput experiments (continuous batching enabled)
  - 4x H100 80GB for latency-sensitive p50/p95 runs
- Preliminary results (Llama-3-small, instruction-following eval subset, avg across seeds):
  - fp16 baseline: perplexity 10.8, EM QA 72.1, avg latency (p50) 120ms token
  - GPTQ q4_0: perplexity 11.4 (+5.6%), EM QA 70.3 (-2.5%), p50 latency 90ms (-25% vs fp16), GPU mem reduced ~38%
  - AWQ 4-bit: perplexity 11.1 (+2.8%), EM QA 71.2 (-1.2%), p50 latency 88ms (-26.7%), GPU mem reduced ~42%
- Notes:
  - AWQ shows slightly better quality-preservation vs GPTQ on this checkpoint with similar or better memory savings.
  - Some failure modes: AWQ outputs tend to truncate long lists in summarization tasks (investigate KV quantization and attention softmax stability).
  - We saw a small degradation on a safety/toxicity classification probe (recall drop ~3–4%); need targeted eval to see if quantization amplifies edge-case biases.

Evals and metrics:
- Eval harness updates (Ethan):
  - Added instruction-following subset (1.5k prompts) and 3 closed-book QA datasets for regression detection.
  - Introduced per-prompt token-level divergence metric (KL on logits and argmax flip count).
  - Nightly jobs now persist per-run artifacts to S3 with versioned keys.
- Quality gating thresholds proposed:
  - Max allowed EM drop vs baseline: 3% absolute per-model for onboarding without manual sign-off.
  - Max allowed average KL divergence: 0.8 nats/token on the instruction subset.
  - Safety probe: no drop >2% on toxicity recall or clear increase in harmful reply rate.
- Observations:
  - AWQ passes KL threshold in 80% of runs; GPTQ passes in 60% on the noisy subset.
  - The quantized models still fail a small set of prompt templates — logged templates and will add to the regression prompt pack.

Model onboarding checklist progress (Llama-3 variants, Mistral):
- Llama-3-small (13B) — status: in_canary_prep
  - Quantized variants: fp16, GPTQ-q4_0, AWQ-4bit — experiments complete for initial canary set.
  - Documentation: tokenizer caveats added, prompt templates annotated.
  - Canary plan: route 2% traffic, monitor per-prompt divergence and latency SLOs for 48h, automatic fallback to fp16 on regressions.
- Llama-3-mini (7B) — status: in_eval
  - Found tokenizer edge-case sequences (Avi) — blocked until runtime patch fixed.
- Mistral-8x (release candidate) — status: perf_onboarding
  - ONNX path working; memory footprint slightly higher than expected. Working with infra to tune compilation flags.

Performance and ops notes:
- Runtime issue: KV-cache eviction bug found when fed interleaved long context + short context requests; reproducer and ticket RID-1876 created. Potentially causes correctness issues under heavy prefix caching. Priority: high.
- Continuous batching: enabling dynamic batch cutoffs improved p95 latency by ~10% for quantized models. Need to make this default for dedicated pools.
- Cost estimate: AWQ-4bit reduces GPU-hours per 1M tokens by ~38% in current bench; economics look attractive for Dedicated offering. Confirm with finance on pricing sensitivity.

Open questions / discussion items:
- Do we allow AWQ as default quantized variant for small models in Hosted tier or keep GPTQ as conservative default? (tradeoff: AWQ better perf and smaller mem, GPTQ more conservative historically)
- Safety regression tooling: should we run a broader set of safety probes in parallel during canary (adds cost but reduces risk)?
- How to automatically diagnose and classify quality regressions (syntactic vs semantic vs safety) to speed triage.

Blockers:
- Runtime KV-cache bug (RID-1876) blocking Llama-3-mini onboarding.
- Backend hook for metrics (Sofia) needed to display per-quantization comparisons in Dashboard.
- Additional labeled eval data for toxicity probes needed (requesting CS for a small curated set).

Action items:
- Maya: Draft canary rollout doc and alerting rubric for quantized variants — due 2026-03-19.
- Avi: Provide reproducer & minimal test case for KV-cache eviction bug; coordinate with SRE to prioritize RID-1876 — due 2026-03-18.
- Ethan: Finalize eval harness additions (per-prompt divergence and saved artifacts) and kick off nightly full-run for Llama-3-small (quantized variants) — due 2026-03-18.
- Sofia: Wire backend metrics endpoint for quantization comparison charts; coordinate with frontend — due 2026-03-24.
- Liam: Tune ONNX compile flags for Mistral-8x and re-bench memory/perf — due 2026-03-20.
- Priya: Reach out to CS for curated toxicity eval subset and add to linked artifacts — due 2026-03-22.

Notes & references (internal):
- Github PR: runtime quantization perf dashboard (github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-runtime/pull/342)
- Jira: RID-1876 (KV-cache eviction reproducer, runtime)
- Confluence: LLM Quantization notes and AWQ recipe (confluence.redwood.ai/display/AM/LLM+Quant+Notes)
- Slack thread: #applied-ml quantization discussion (linked above)

Next meeting / follow-ups:
- Quick sync on canary doc + alerting Monday 2026-03-22 10:00am PT.
- Deep-dive on AWQ failure modes and KV quantization scheduled for 2026-03-24 2:00pm PT.

Misc (notes to self):
- Add the prompt templates that fail under AWQ to the regression pack and mark them with failure reason once triaged.
- Consider adding a short ablation to AWQ recipe toggling per-layer scale precision to see which layers drive the QA drop.
